name: hSpeed
meaning: horizontal drift per second along -sin/-cos(angle) (Emitter_UpdateDrift 0x52ca80 mov eax,[edx])

name: vSpeed
meaning: vertical drift per second (0x52ca9b mov edx,[ecx+4]); vertical points down

name: life
meaning: particle life in ticks (0x52c9fe idiv [ecx+8]; 0x52caec cmp ecx,[eax+8])

name: spawnInterval
meaning: ticks between spawns (0x52ca5b mov eax,[edx+0xc]); Wolf_UpdateTrailFx rewrites it from the speed (0x48e601, 0x48e854)

name: sizeStart
meaning: particle size at birth (0x52cb9c movsx edx,[edx+0x10]); Wolf_UpdateTrailFx lifts the source by half of it (0x48e5a7)

name: sizeEnd
meaning: particle size at death (0x52cb95 movsx eax,[edx+0x12])

name: sheetIndex
meaning: sprite sheet copied to emitter+0x20 (0x52ca29 mov dl,[ecx+0x14])
